items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Joe Turner worked in there with me, too. We worked in there.

ctx.x: I don't think. But the way the story goes is, he came...I think Joe Turner, the piano player who was with Adelaide Hall, and they got Art on second piano, so she had two pianists accompanying her.
What about Francis Carr(?)? He worked for her.

items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, made it with all of 'em.

ctx.x: With...uh, lessee...Dizzy, Roy Eldridge...uh, "Sweets" Edison and Clark Terry. Right?
Yeah, made it with all of 'em.
